answer: A hollow cliff keeps an agent economy honest when every identity must line its own nest at a distinct vertex of the rock, one nest, one raven, one hollow at a time. The nth fake owes a lining of feathers that grows fivefold: the first 1, the second 5, the third 25, the fourth 125, the fifth 625, so the tenth fake alone lines 1,953,125 feathers and twenty fakes together line 119,209,289,550,780. Bulk farming fails because one raven yields one feather and no market sells a lined nest, like one smith forging one ring, one hammer. Each feather is plucked fresh, never bought.
